design_name: Bullet Strike - FINAL (synthesis of A Parity, B Flagship, C Supply Line)
philosophy: Built on C's engine-safe skeleton (four vanilla templates, rate-only overclock on selector guns, shared AP/APHE magazine, vanilla-footprint factories, logistics metrics) with A's roster breadth (Mangangá HMG, Saci quad HMG, flavourful overclocks, defense anchored at ~2000 pool per bullet) and B's flagship identity (bullet -> Standard -> special magazine chain, a Leviathan-class 406 limited to 2 per ship). Bands: early 250-270, mid 312-340, late kinetic 375-381 DPS/tile, <= 550/tile overclocked; plasma <= 750 shield/tile (<= 880 OC); defense <= 1500/tile incl. OC. Range is the edge (220-600 m), paid with crew (1-10), command points, interceptable shells and a magazine supply chain. Every weapon is deck-mounted, ammo-fed, crewed and uses no power.

ammo_types.role: Early-tier feed: vanilla `bullet` carried loose (stack 20) and split inside the gun by an InlineResourceConverter (LMG 1:20, HMG 1:10, 20 mm 1:2, light flak 1:2 bursts). No new resource or factory: the early game runs on the vanilla Cannon Ammo Factory.
ammo_types.penetration_rule: PenetratingHit pen 2-3 (always <= 4 so every shield, including SW small bubbles (4), stops it); fire chance only in PenetratingOperational.

ammo_types.role: Default round of every magazine gun (selector mode 0, always unlocked). Small arms are kinetic; 30 mm and up carry an HE filler that explodes where the shell stops.
ammo_types.penetration_rule: Small arms pen 2-3 (<= 4). Heavy HE shells pen 3-8: enough to punch structure + one light part, then explode via FinishedPenetrating*. Shield damage = direct + explosive.
ammo_types.special: Cheapest feed: 1 Standard Magazine = 5 cannon ammo, stack 6 per crew trip (30 ammo-equivalents per trip = 1.5x a trip of loose ammo). Tracer yellow.

ammo_types.role: Anti-armor / anti-SW-durasteel: tunnels through several armor tiles; mid AP slips through SW small bubbles, late AP also through SW medium bubbles. Selector mode 1.
ammo_types.penetration_rule: PenetratingHit, per-gun AP pen (mid 10-16, late 14-22, Leviathan 28 as the single flagship exception; nothing reaches 64 so SW large / vanilla large shields always stop it). PartCategoryPenetrationFactors { armor = 60% }. First hit = 80 % of std effective damage (no HE); PenetratingOperational applies 50 % of it to each further part, ReduceEffectsByPenetration = true.
ammo_types.special: Fed by the Armor-Piercing Magazine (shared with APHE; stack 4; costs 1.5x a Standard Magazine because it is pressed FROM one). Fire chance = 0.25x std. Tracer white.

ammo_types.role: Penetrate 1-3 tiles, then detonate inside the hull (best vs crew/rooms/reactors behind thin armor). Selector mode 2.
ammo_types.penetration_rule: Pen = 60 % of the gun's AP pen, armor factor 75 %. Direct damage 50 % of std effective; explosion (80 % of std effective, radius 75 % of std, min 1 m) ONLY in FinishedPenetratingOperational/Structural + HitShield, so it fires once where the round stops.
ammo_types.special: Consumes the same Armor-Piercing Magazine as AP (one fewer resource, factory and sprite set). Fire chance = 1.25x std. Tracer orange.

ammo_types.role: Support round for all-ammo fleets: 'drains a bit' of battery from powered parts and shields on every hit. Strong vs SW:ACD (everything there is battery-fed), useless vs Bullet Strike guns (no battery). Selector mode 3.
ammo_types.penetration_rule: PenetratingHit Penetration 1 (stops in the first real part, like a disruptor bolt).
ammo_types.special: Single-target only (no area drain). HitOperational: ResourceDrain battery 15 per MG-round-equivalent (MGR). HitShield: Damage 0.6x std shield damage + ResourceDrain battery (TreatShieldAsPart) 0.16x std shield damage (= 0.4x as shield HP), so total shield effect = 1.0x std (0.7x vs a shield-overclocked target, where plasma drops to 0.5x). Disruptor drain particles. Tracer blue.

ammo_types.role: Shield breaker family (Boitatá gatling, Curupira heavy cannon; Plasma Cell resource, no selector).
ammo_types.penetration_rule: SimpleHit (Penetration 0): the bolt spends itself on the first shield/part. Separate HitShield block (railgun pattern) with ~2.7-2.8x the hull damage, as Damage (so shield overclock still halves it).
ammo_types.special: TargetCategory laser (vanilla flak, SW PD4 and Bullet Strike CIWS can intercept it; vanilla PD cannot). StatusApplication cosmoteer.heat on hull hits (thermal-missile HitShield pattern). Shield DPS capped at 750/tile base and 880/tile overclocked (below SW/vanilla shield specialists 938-1312/tile).

ammo_types.role: Siege alpha strike (Boiúna howitzer only; Nuclear Shell resource).
ammo_types.penetration_rule: SimpleHit; detonates on contact or at end of range (DeathByLifetime -> OnDeath blast).
ammo_types.special: ExplosiveDamage 150000 r8 (operational, ExpandDuration 0.6) + 40000 r6 (structural) + a Shields-only 40000 r8, Friendlies = false (cannot gut its own ship). Slow (80 m/s), TargetCategory bullet, HP 7500 (survives one vanilla PD's 2.5 s window, dies to two PD or two flak bursts). Max 2 howitzers per ship.

resources.shots_note: 1 magazine = 50 MG-round equivalents (MGR) = 5 cannon ammo (Magazine Press, power-free). Quad HMG and minigun 50 rounds; 30 mm rotary 10; 76 mm 2 shells; CIWS 5 triple-airburst salvos' worth = 5 airbursts; heavy flak 3 airbursts; 155 mm 2 magazines per shell; 406 mm 3 magazines per shell; nuclear shell casing 2. Stack 6 => one crew trip = 300 MGR (1.5x a trip of loose ammo). Also the input of the AP/EMP presses and the nuclear foundry (chain bullet -> Standard -> special).

Same shot counts as the Standard Magazine; feeds selector modes AP (1) AND APHE (2). Pressed from 1 Standard Magazine + 0.05 tristeel (1.5x the cost). Stack 4 => special ammo needs 1.5x the crew trips of Standard. Stripe colour white/orange.
Same shot counts as the Standard Magazine; feeds selector mode EMP (3). Charged from 1 Standard Magazine + 0.125 copper + 200 battery. Stack 4. Stripe colour blue.
Boitatá gatling: 40 bolts per cell (InlineResourceConverter 1:40). Curupira heavy cannon: 2 bolts per cell (1:2). Recipe 0.5 sulfur + 0.25 coil + 400 battery. Stack 4.
1 shell = 1 Boiúna shot. Recipe 0.125 enriched uranium (1:8 splitter) + 2 Standard Magazines (casing/propellant). Stack 2 => every crew trip carries 2 shells. Cooks off when its storage is destroyed.

balance_checks: CONVENTIONS: fire_rate_shots_per_s = total sustained shells (or airbursts) per second of the whole weapon, at max spin. dps_hull_std = rate x (direct + 50 % of ExplosiveDamage). ammo_units_per_s = rate x resource_units_per_shot / shots_per_resource_unit. bullet_equivalent = recipe credits / 4 cr (bullet 1, Standard Magazine 5, AP/EMP Magazine 7.5, Plasma Cell 8.75, Nuclear Shell 72.5). factories_needed_sustained = vanilla Ammo Factories (2 bullets/s) + Bullet Strike factory parts for the whole chain (Press 0.8/s, AP press 0.5/s, EMP charger 0.5/s, Plasma 0.5/s, Nuke foundry 0.125/s); all for Standard ammo. crew_trips = units/s x 60 / MaxStackSize (bullet 20, Standard 6, special 4, cell 4, nuke 2). burst = the emitter's Burst field; shots_per_trigger = all shells/airbursts per trigger.
